# Drawing scripts of the SVG driver golden tests. The language is described
# in ../svgtest/script.go; testdata/javagen/SvgGolden.java runs the same
# scripts with the upstream jar and writes golden/<case>.svg.

case empty
write

case rect-basic
color #FF0000
bg #00FF00
translate 10 20
rect 30 40
write

case rect-rounded-shadow
color #181818
bg #F1F1F1
translate 10.5 7.25
rect 72.031 48 5 4
translate 100 0
rect 20 20 0 3
rect 20 20 10 0
write

case rect-degenerate
color #181818
bg #F1F1F1
push
clip 0 0 5 5
translate 3 3
rect 10 10
translate 10 0
rect 3 3
translate -10 10
rect 3 3
translate -20 -20
rect 4 4
pop
rect 1e-9 1e-9
translate 1e6 -3
rect 2 2
write

line 30 0

stroke 0
rect 10 10
line 10 10
stroke 0.00001
rect 10 10
stroke -0.0001
rect 10 10
write

case groups

bg #F1F1F1

endgroup

line 10 10

rect 3 3
endgroup
endgroup
group CLASS=empty
endgroup
group TITLE=only\stitle
endgroup
write

case links

url https://example.com

rect 10 10
endurl

endurl

line 3 3
endurl
url javascript:alert(1)
rect 4 4
endurl
url JaVa\sScRiPt:alert(2)
rect 4 4
endurl
url http://empty.example
endurl
write

case links-nested
url http://outer
rect 10 10
url http://inner tip
rect 5 5
endurl
rect 6 6
endurl

url http://in-group
rect 2 2
group CLASS=inner
rect 3 3
endgroup
rect 4 4
endurl
endgroup
url http://around
group CLASS=g2
rect 1 1
endgroup
endurl
write
